Positioning a region for technology investment

Connecting a regional proposition with media visibility, business outreach and first-hand engagement.

The objective

Help an Indian state position two of its cities as destinations for offshore development centres, highlighting their infrastructure, talent pool and government incentives.

Shyam’s contribution

As CEO and Chief of Strategy at a public relations and business consulting firm, Shyam developed an integrated communications and business-engagement strategy.

Working with the state’s IT department and appointed strategy partners, he shaped messages and supporting material for Indian and international media, planned roadshows to engage prospective businesses directly, and organised visits for company representatives to assess the destination first-hand.

The outputs

  • More than 100 news articles.
  • Roadshows across five Indian cities and two US cities.
  • Outreach reaching more than 1,000 companies.
  • Site visits for representatives of more than 100 IT-services companies, to experience the destination first-hand.

Source: Shyam Sundar Pani’s account.

The experience this brings

Translating regional strengths into a proposition businesses can assess, supported by targeted communication and direct engagement.

Related services

  • Grow your market presence
  • Establish cross-border operations
  • Bring organizations together to deliver

Linked as transferable experience, not as a Japan–India assignment.
